overall: Informal resolution finding no OML violation for the chair muting the complainant during a Zoom public comment exchange. Deliberation and minutes allegations were declined as unspecific; the AG also flagged, unprompted, a possibly vague May 28 meeting notice and strongly discouraged using technology to silence members. No orders issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair cut her off during a Zoom public hearing portion and had her muted after she was told her comment was off topic.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the Chair did not violate the Open Meeting Law where, during the public hearing portion of the May 28 meeting held via Zoom, he informed the Complainant that her question was not on topic and directed that the Complainant be muted.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that much deliberation takes place outside public meetings by leadership members, with no specific incidents identified.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint does not include any specific information with respect to these allegations, we decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that meeting minutes often do not include her comments.
allegations.key_passage: First, we decline to review this complaint with respect to the allegations that “much deliberation takes place outside of public meetings,” and that meeting minutes often do not include the Complainant’s comments.

allegations.summary: Not alleged by complainant; AG raised on its own that the May 28 meeting notice appears too vague about anticipated topics such as applications, warrant articles, and minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Here, if the Chair anticipated that particular applications, warrant articles, and meeting minutes would be discussed at the May 28 meeting, then these details should have been included on the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Several non-OML allegations: c.44b hearing notice, emails omitted from packets, chair representing committee at selectmen meeting, and unanswered emails and records requests.
allegations.key_passage: Because each of these allegations, even if true, would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, we decline to review these allegations.
